entry_timeframe_note: Use Daily for bias. Drop to 4H for entry timing — confirm TWB signal on 4H before entering.
required_indicators: Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks [LuxAlgo]

long: Symbol TWB Histogram positive and above its signal line
NW: price inside bands or approaching upper band (not extended outside)
S/R: price above sr_support; bonus if sr_break > 0 (resistance just broke)
skip: TWB Histogram negative — no new longs
NW: price extended above upper band without S/R breakout confirmation
S/R: price rejected at sr_resistance with negative TWB

spot_long: Symbol TWB Histogram positive AND above signal line
4H chart confirms same TWB bullish breakout
NW: price inside bands, or sr_break > 0 overrides NW extension (breakout confirmation)
Volume above average on breakout candle (USD terms)

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below breakout candle low or nearest prior swing low on Daily.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 when price touches upper NW Envelope band.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Scale out 1/3 at 2R. Trail remainder with 4H 9 EMA.
exit_criteria.take_profit_3: Exit final 1/3 if price closes below 4H 9 EMA for two consecutive candles.
exit_criteria.emergency_exit: Exit ALL positions immediately if BTC drops 8%+ intraday.

risk_rules: Maximum 2% account risk per crypto trade
Maximum 3 open crypto positions at once
Never average down on a losing crypto trade
No crypto trading during major macro events (FOMC, CPI)
If BTC drops 8%+ intraday, exit ALL crypto positions
asset_notes: Coinbase spot — USD pairs only (COINBASE:BTCUSD, not BINANCE:BTCUSDT). Each symbol is evaluated on its own TWB + NW + S/R reading. Use BTC's reading as session context when evaluating alts.
